- [EVENT] User is thinking of shopping around for new car insurance quotes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Geico is a popular auto insurance provider in the United States, known for competitive rates and extensive coverage options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Geico's average annual premium is around $1,300, which is lower than the national average of $1,500.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A standard Geico auto insurance policy typically includes liability coverage, collision coverage, comprehensive coverage, personal injury protection (PIP), and uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Optional coverage offered by Geico includes roadside assistance, rental car coverage, accident forgiveness, and new car replacement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Geico offers various discounts, including multi-car discount, multi-policy discount, good student discount, military discount, defensive driving course discount, and good driver discount.
- [EVENT] User is considering getting roadside assistance coverage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Geico's Roadside Assistance program provides 24/7 help with towing, fuel delivery, lockout service, battery jump-starts, and tire changes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The cost of adding roadside assistance to a Geico policy averages around $14 to $30 per year.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Basic Roadside Assistance costs approximately $14 to $20 per year, while Premium Roadside Assistance costs about $20 to $30 per year.
- [EVENT] User is wondering if Geico has any special discounts for people who take good care of their cars.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Geico offers a Vehicle Maintenance Discount for regular maintenance, which can save around 5% to 10% on the auto insurance premium.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Proof of regular maintenance may include maintenance records, oil change receipts, and vehicle inspection reports.
